variety: Standard Thai (ภาษาไทยมาตรฐาน)
register: Concise, respectful contemporary software/game Thai. Omit gendered polite particles in neutral interface labels; do not add English-style word spaces. Preserve product names, IDs, placeholders, paths and URLs. Use authored ASCII numbers in game instructions; do not alter simulation or technical formats. Editorial reconciliation selects ยูนิต (entity classifier ตัว) and แมตช์ for played matches; these are deliberate gaming loanwords.

sources.consulted: Lookup form and public func_lookup.php endpoint; actual returned entries individually consulted below.

lookups.interpretation: A worker performing labour; appropriate functional label for gathering/building units, without implying a military unit.
A person skilled in fighting, soldier; matches combat unit.
To inspect or search for things such as mineral resources; supports the explorer scouting role.
An elongated raised accumulation of sediment in water; the terrain sense of bar, not a drinking establishment.
Route crossing a mountain range or gap between mountains; confirms terrain pass.
The second noun sense is an animal/insect home used for shelter and raising young; matches the birth-producing building and French/Japanese references.
Traveller accommodation/inn; valid literal term, but the game food role should be explicit in its explanation.

sources.interpretation: Thai uses horizontal left-to-right text; spaces delimit phrases. Vowels and tone marks surround consonants, requiring correct positioning and adequate height.

consulted_sections: Languages that have no word separators
sources.interpretation: Thai normally wraps at semantic word boundaries rather than arbitrary characters. U+200B can mark opportunities; reviewed break hints must preserve syllables and marks.

Independent editor selected a common Thai gaming loanword to distinguish game entities from generic units, organizations, or goods. Use classifier ตัว for entity counts; retain หน่วย only for measurement units. Meaning reviewer accepts this consistent neutral game register.
